notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
A new update is available, this one fixes some dialogues in English.
- A serious game breaking bug, on the forest level, where you have to find the pigs, where you would get stuck and wouldn't find anything.
- We are working on fixing the bug where bullets and arrows get stuck in the air.
- The save game is also not working right now and we are fixing it as well!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello dear natives! 

You requested a smarter AI, and here is an update for it, the AI was acting strangely, trying to beat the corpses, and after dyeing, they would keep blocking for some time, no more!
 Also, some soldiers would keep quiet and standing still while the fight was going on, but now, if someone shoots or get hurt, the others around him will shoot at the attacker.
 I also made their reload faster, and with some random speed.

If you find any bugs, please report, It's not hard for me to fix, and a lot of them are happening with different machines, so please let me know if you find any!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Our first patch fixing some annoying bugs is released and here is the changelog:

- Added more information about controls
- Fixed a bug where the dialog box would stay on the River boat level.
- Fixed a bug where the player would fall through the world
- Fixed some triggers which were not working 100%

If you find a bug or want something improved, let's us know!
